ide.inlineDiff.enablePerformanceProtecti.markdownDescription: Enable performance protection for inline diffs. When enabled, inline diff decorations will be suppressed if there are too many changes to prevent editor unresponsiveness.

ide.inlineDiff.maxDecorations.markdownDescription: Maximum number of inline diff changes before decorations are suppressed. Mirrors `inline_diff_performance_config.maxDecorations` (requires `ide.inlineDiff.enablePerformanceProtection`).

ide.cpp.enablePartialAccepts.markdownDescription: Enable partial accept/reject of individual changes in an inline edit diff preview. When disabled, only the full Accept/Reject commands apply. Inspired by Cursor's `cursor.cpp.enablePartialAccepts` (Cursor 3.25.9) — note Cursor's toggle gates Tab's next-word partial accept, while this one applies the same idea to inline-edit hunks (Cursor has no config gate on inline-diff partial edit). This is a different feature from `ide.tab.enablePartialAccepts`, which is the true equivalent of Cursor's toggle for Tab's next-word partial accept.

ide.onboarding.showChecklist.markdownDescription: Show the IDE Agent onboarding checklist view. Uncheck to hide it once you're finished; the checklist can be shown again with the "IDE Agent: Show Onboarding Checklist" command.

ide.bugbot.autoReviewOnCommit.markdownDescription: Automatically review your changes for issues after each commit (Cursor's verbatim "Start Agent Review on Commit" setting). Settings-UI surface for the `autoRunBugbotOnCommit` storage flag; the `cursor.enableAutoReviewOnCommit` command enables the same flag.
ide.bugbot.autoReviewOnCommit.title: Start Agent Review on Commit

ide.git.attributeCommitsToAgent.markdownDescription: Mark Agent commits as 'Made with Cursor' (Cursor's verbatim "Commit Attribution" setting, storage key `attributeCommitsToAgent`, default true in Cursor 3.25.9). Settings-UI surface for the attribution flag the agent request context carries as `commitAttributionMessage: "enabled"`; when off, the field is omitted and Agent commits get no `Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>` trailer.
ide.git.attributeCommitsToAgent.title: Commit Attribution

ide.git.attributePRsToAgent.markdownDescription: Mark pull requests as made with Cursor (Cursor's verbatim "PR Attribution" setting, storage key `attributePRsToAgent`, default true in Cursor 3.25.9). Settings-UI surface for the attribution flag the agent request context carries as `prAttributionMessage: "enabled"`; when off, the field is omitted and Agent pull requests are not marked.
ide.git.attributePRsToAgent.title: PR Attribution

ide.agent.privacyMode.markdownDescription: Privacy mode reported by the `cursor.getPrivacyModeEnum()` extension API. Enum names are verbatim from Cursor's `aiserver.v1.PrivacyMode`. HONEST-DIVERGENCE: Cursor derives this per-account from its auth service; this fork has no Cursor account, so the local setting is authoritative. Defaults to NO_STORAGE (never store code remotely).

ide.agent.featureGates.markdownDescription: Local feature-gate overrides backing the `cursor.checkFeatureGate()` extension API, as a map of gate name to boolean. HONEST-DIVERGENCE: Cursor's gates are server-driven via its experiment service; this fork resolves gates locally and unknown gates are false.

ide.agent.dynamicConfig.markdownDescription: Local dynamic-config values backing the `cursor.getDynamicConfigValue()` extension API, as a map of config key to value. HONEST-DIVERGENCE: Cursor serves these server-side via its experiment service; this fork resolves them locally and unknown keys are undefined.

ide.agent.egressAllowedFeatures.markdownDescription: Feature keys whose network egress is explicitly decided as allowed, backing the `cursor.isFeatureEgressAllowed()` privacy egress gate. Only `github-context` consults this list: Cursor documents "all GitHub egress stays off until it is decided", so `github-context` egress stays blocked even with privacy mode off until its key is listed here.

ide.worktreeMaxCount.markdownDescription: Maximum number of IDE-managed worktrees to retain across all workspaces. Older worktrees are removed first when the limit is exceeded (worktrees that are git-locked or have uncommitted changes are kept). Mirrors Cursor's `cursor.worktreeMaxCount` (default 25).

ide.worktreeCleanupIntervalHours.markdownDescription: How often (in hours) the periodic worktree cleanup pass runs: it enforces `ide.worktreeMaxCount` and `ide.worktreesGlobalMaxSizeGb`, removing the oldest worktrees first. Mirrors Cursor's `cursor.worktreeCleanupIntervalHours` (default 6).

ide.worktreesGlobalMaxSizeGb.markdownDescription: Maximum total size (GB) of all IDE-managed worktrees across all workspaces. When exceeded, the oldest worktrees are removed first until the total is under the limit. Set to 0 to disable the limit. Mirrors Cursor's `cursor.worktreesGlobalMaxSizeGb` (default 50, 0 = disabled).

ide.agent.scheduledTasksEnabled.markdownDescription: Enable the local scheduled-tasks runner (Cursor parity: GlassLocalScheduledTasksService). The runner is feature-gated off by default, mirroring Cursor's experiment-gate behavior. Scheduled prompts open in a new agent chat and run with the agent defaults.

ide.agent.scheduledTasks.markdownDescription: Scheduled tasks for the local scheduled-tasks runner (Cursor parity: GlassLocalScheduledTasksService, feature `local-scheduled-tasks-runner`). Each task has: id (string), cron (5-field UTC cron, e.g. "0 9 * * 1-5"), prompt (string, the agent instruction to run), enabled (boolean), and an optional modelConfig ({modelName, maxMode, selectedModels} — defaults to {modelName:"default", maxMode:false, selectedModels:[]} per Cursor's model-config parser). Tasks only fire while `ide.agent.scheduledTasksEnabled` is true.

ide.integrations.github.clientId.markdownDescription: OAuth client ID of the OAuth App you register with GitHub for this IDE's direct GitHub integration (authorization-code + PKCE flow against `https://github.com/login/oauth/authorize`, scopes `repo` and `read:user` — see `src/integrations/providers.ts`). Used by the `IDE Agent: Connect Integration` flow to create, update, and merge pull requests and read repositories. Leave empty to fall back to the `IDE_INTEGRATIONS_GITHUB_CLIENT_ID` environment variable. Machine scope: the value is read only from user (machine) settings, never from a workspace, so it cannot be committed with a repository.

ide.integrations.github.clientSecret.markdownDescription: OAuth client secret of the same GitHub OAuth App as `ide.integrations.github.clientId`. It is sent only during the token exchange with `https://github.com/login/oauth/access_token` (and only when non-empty); the resulting access tokens are stored in the OS keychain-backed SecretStorage. Leave empty to fall back to the `IDE_INTEGRATIONS_GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET` environment variable. Never commit this value — machine scope keeps it in user (machine) settings only, never in a workspace.

ide.integrations.linear.clientId.markdownDescription: OAuth client ID of the OAuth application you register with Linear for this IDE's direct Linear integration (authorization-code + PKCE flow against `https://linear.app/oauth/authorize`, scopes `read` and `write` — see `src/integrations/providers.ts`). Used by the `IDE Agent: Connect Integration` flow to read and update Linear issues, projects, and cycles. Leave empty to fall back to the `IDE_INTEGRATIONS_LINEAR_CLIENT_ID` environment variable. Machine scope: the value is read only from user (machine) settings, never from a workspace, so it cannot be committed with a repository.

ide.integrations.linear.clientSecret.markdownDescription: OAuth client secret of the same Linear OAuth application as `ide.integrations.linear.clientId`. It is sent only during the token exchange with `https://linear.app/oauth/token` (and only when non-empty); the resulting access tokens are stored in the OS keychain-backed SecretStorage. Leave empty to fall back to the `IDE_INTEGRATIONS_LINEAR_CLIENT_SECRET` environment variable. Never commit this value — machine scope keeps it in user (machine) settings only, never in a workspace.
